title: AI Code Prep v2: AI Code Prep rewritten from the ground up in Rust for speed | Product Hunt
excerpt: It has no problem handling the biggest folders and repos, has compression modes with live preview for compressing giant repos into the available context window of LLMs, secrets detection & optional redaction to keep things like API keys from leaving your machines, less features vs v1 to keep the interface simple and easy to use. It has one main goal which is to get many files into a LLM preferred format to paste into ChatGPT, Claude, any web interface or other. A common workflow when using AI.
